IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE * FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL * DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR * SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER * CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, * OR TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE * OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE. */ package com.pbolduc.mapcompanion; /** * The plugin's version, in one place. * *

It was spelled out as a literal in {@link RelayClient} and again in {@link DirectiveStream}, * which is two places to forget on a release — and a user-agent that still claims 1.0.0 is worse * than none at all, because the operator reads it and believes it. * *

The number here has to match {@code version} in {@code build.gradle}. That is the one copy * left, and it is the one a release checklist can actually see. */ final class CompanionVersion { static final String VERSION = "1.5.0"; /** * The version {@link UpdateNotice#LINE} was written for. That line is said under {@link #VERSION} * as what this version changed, so a release that moves the number writes the line again and * moves this with it; {@code UpdateNoticeTest} fails while the two differ, because the last * release's news under a new number tells an updated player nothing true. */ static final String LINE_VERSION = "1.5.0"; /** How every request this plugin makes identifies itself. */ static final String USER_AGENT = "osrs-map-companion/" + VERSION + " (RuneLite plugin)"; private CompanionVersion() { } }

Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright notice, * this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the documentation * and/or other materials provided with the distribution. * * THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS "AS IS" * AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, THE * IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE * DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE * FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL * DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR * SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER * CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, * OR TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE * OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE. */ package com.pbolduc.mapcompanion; /** * The handful of game variables this plugin reads, in one place. * *

Why these are here rather than inline. This is the single most version-sensitive * surface in the plugin: the ids themselves are stable game data, but the constants that name them * have moved between {@code net.runelite.api.Varbits}, {@code VarPlayer}, and the generated * {@code gameval} classes across client releases. Collecting them means a client update touches one * file, and a reviewer can see the entire set of game variables this plugin reads without reading * the rest of it. * *

Each literal is asserted. Literals let this repository build against a range of client * releases, and the price is that the compiler checks none of them. {@code VarbitIdsTest} compares * every one with its {@code net.runelite.api.gameval.VarPlayerID} constant, so a new id here gets * its line there in the same commit: the rule in CONTRIBUTING's Rules a change must keep. * *

A wrong one fails quietly by design: {@link SlayerTaskReader} returns null when it cannot * resolve a name, and the map shows no task rather than the wrong one. That quiet is why the * assertion is a test and not a step someone remembers before a release. */ final class VarPlayerIds { /** How many of the current assignment are left. */ static final int SLAYER_COUNT = 394; /** Which creature is assigned. 98 is the sentinel meaning "a boss, named separately". */ static final int SLAYER_TARGET = 395; /** The area the assignment is restricted to, when a master gives one. 0 for none. */ static final int SLAYER_AREA = 2096; private VarPlayerIds() { } }

Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright notice, * this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the documentation * and/or other materials provided with the distribution. * * THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS "AS IS" * AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, THE * IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE * DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE * FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL * DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR * SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER * CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, * OR TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE * OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE. */ package com.pbolduc.mapcompanion; import net.runelite.client.externalplugins.ExternalPluginManager; import net.runelite.client.RuneLite; /** * Launches a RuneLite client with this plugin loaded, for developing it. * *

Not a test — it asserts nothing and JUnit never calls it. It lives under {@code src/test} * because that is where the client dependency is, and because a launcher that shipped inside the * plugin jar would be dead weight in everybody's install. This is the shape the Plugin Hub template * uses and the way essentially every plugin in the Hub is actually developed. * *

Run {@link #main} from an IDE with {@code -ea} enabled. RuneLite starts, this plugin appears in * the configuration list under its own name, and it can be turned on and watched against a real * account — which is the only way to check the parts of this repository that a unit test cannot * reach, since almost all of them are reads of live game state. * *

The one genuinely testable piece, the coordinate solver, has its own real test beside this * file. Everything else needs a client, and this is the client. */ public class MapCompanionPluginTest { /** * The varargs parameter is a generic array, which javac warns about at every call site and which * no caller can avoid — the warning belongs to {@code loadBuiltin}'s signature, not to this line. * Suppressed narrowly so that {@code -Xlint:all} stays worth reading, which is the whole reason * this build turns it on. */ @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ExternalPluginManager.loadBuiltin(MapCompanionPlugin.class); RuneLite.main(args); } }
